text: I sense a contradiction between the sterile, controlled environment around me and the lively invitation to innovation and research. The repeated mention of the U.S. Department of Homeland Security lingers in my mind, coloring my thoughts with an awareness of surveillance and authority. Yet, the colorful 'R+D' wall draws my curiosity, urging me to reflect on the roles of creativity and security in society. I feel both anxious and intrigued, as if standing at the crossroads of constraint and possibility.
